# PeopleBase

> PeopleBase is a small open source HR system built with Flask and SQLAlchemy. It keeps employee records, departments, reporting lines, compensation history with effective dates, and time-off requests with a manager approval rule, and shows a people dashboard and an org chart. All server code is in one module (app.py) with server-rendered Jinja templates, CSRF protection, a strict Content-Security-Policy, spreadsheet-safe CSV export and a pytest suite. It has no login and is meant for demo data on a private network.
